name: Scourge
description: Add a random negative affix with an Affinity of your choice, then the same points (multiplied by -1) are added to another affix of your choice

name: Tweak
description: Reroll an affix of your choice, using the original affix's point value as the new one's minimum
upgrade: +1 min point value to new affix/1

name: Enhance
upgrade: +1 min point value to new affix/2

name: Optimise
description: Add a random affix of the same Affinity as a random one of the highest-point affixes on the item.
upgrade: +1 min point value to new affix/2

name: Purify
description: Remove all lowest-point-value affixes from the item and give all removed points to a random remaining affix. If there is no remaining affix, instead add a new random affix with a minimum point value equal to the points removed.

name: Negate
description: An affix of your choice has its point value multiplied by -1, then the points lost are granted to another random affix on the item.

name: Inspire
description: An affix of your choice is disabled until a random mission (chosen now) is completed. When it is revealed, it is automatically upgraded once.

name: Refine
description: An affix of your choice is rerolled within its Affinity, using the original affix's point value as the new one's minimum.
upgrade: +1 min point value to new affix/1
